from openlibrary.catalog.add_book import check_cover_url_host, load
from openlibrary.catalog.add_book.load_book import author_import_record_to_author, import_record_to_edition


def test_cover_host_uses_case_insensitive_hostname():
    assert check_cover_url_host('https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
    assert not check_cover_url_host('https://m.media-amazon.com.evil.test/image', ['m.media-amazon.com'])
    assert not check_cover_url_host(None, ['m.media-amazon.com'])


def test_preview_new_book_exposes_records_without_saving(mock_site, add_languages):
    result = load({'title': 'A preview', 'source_records': ['test:preview'],
                   'authors': [{'name': 'Mr. Smith, John'}], 'languages': ['eng'],
                   'cover': 'https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image'}, save=False)
    assert result['preview'] is True
    assert result['cover_accepted'] is True
    assert {e['type']['key'] for e in result['edits']} == {
        '/type/author', '/type/work', '/type/edition'}
    assert result['edition']['key'].startswith('/books/__new__')
    assert result['work']['key'].startswith('/works/__new__')
    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
    assert result['authors'][0]['name'] == 'John Smith'
    assert all(mock_site.get(e['key']) is None for e in result['edits'])


def test_preview_matched_edition_exposes_added_language_without_saving(mock_site, add_languages):
    original = {'title': 'Existing', 'source_records': ['test:existing']}
    saved = load(original)
    result = load({'title': 'Existing', 'source_records': ['test:existing'],
                   'languages': ['eng']}, save=False)
    assert result['preview'] is True
    assert result['edition']['key'] == saved['edition']['key']
    assert any(e.get('languages') == [{'key': '/languages/eng'}] for e in result['edits'])
    assert not mock_site.get(saved['edition']['key']).get('languages')


def test_renamed_edition_builder_normalizes_author_and_languages(add_languages, mock_site):
    edition = import_record_to_edition({'title': 'Test', 'authors': [{'name': 'Dr. Smith, John'}],
                                        'languages': ['ENG']})
    assert edition['authors'][0]['name'] == 'John Smith'
    assert edition['languages'] == [{'key': '/languages/eng'}]
    assert author_import_record_to_author({'name': 'Mr. Blobby*'})['name'] == 'Blobby*'
EOF
pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_preview.py"

def test_preview_matched_book_exposes_new_work_author_without_saving(mock_site, add_languages):
    mock_site.save({'key': '/works/OL77W', 'type': {'key': '/type/work'}, 'title': 'Known'})
    mock_site.save({'key': '/books/OL77M', 'type': {'key': '/type/edition'},
                    'title': 'Known', 'isbn_10': ['0190906766'],
                    'works': [{'key': '/works/OL77W'}]})
    result = load({'title': 'Known', 'source_records': ['test:known'],
                   'isbn_10': ['0190906766'], 'authors': [{'name': 'New Person'}]},
                  save=False)
    assert result['preview'] is True
    authors = [edit for edit in result['edits'] if edit['type']['key'] == '/type/author']
    assert len(authors) == 1
    assert authors[0]['name'] == 'New Person'
    assert any(edit.get('authors', [{}])[0].get('author', {}).get('key') == authors[0]['key']
               for edit in result['edits'] if edit['type']['key'] == '/type/work')
    assert not mock_site.get('/works/OL77W').get('authors')
EOF

def test_preview_exposes_existing_author_remote_id_change(mock_site, add_languages):
    mock_site.save({'key': '/authors/OL88A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'},
                    'name': 'Jane Example'})
    result = load({'title': 'Remote identifier', 'source_records': ['test:remote'],
                   'authors': [{'name': 'Jane Example', 'remote_ids': {'viaf': '1234'}}]},
                  save=False)
    author_edits = [edit for edit in result['edits']
                    if edit['type']['key'] == '/type/author']
    assert len(author_edits) == 1
    assert author_edits[0]['key'] == '/authors/OL88A'
    assert author_edits[0]['remote_ids'] == {'viaf': '1234'}
    assert not mock_site.get('/authors/OL88A').get('remote_ids')
